summary: Iteration 908 — Full backend verification of the new daily AI Coaching Team push digest wiring (expo-notifications). 13/13 pytest cases passing after transient Cloudflare 429 rate-limit was avoided via inter-request sleeps. All requested checks pass: (1) admin dry-run POST /api/ai-coaching-team/digest/push/run?dry_run=true returns 200 with full summary schema (candidates/sent/skipped_pref/skipped_no_channel/deduped/errors + trigger/dry_run/day), (2) auth guards for the two admin routes correctly reject unauthenticated (401) and non-admin free-user (403) callers, (3) real run (dry_run=false) executes without errors and its summary is retrievable via GET /api/ai-coaching-team/digest/push/runs, (4) POST /api/notifications/push-token with fake ExponentPushToken[testing-agent-fake-token] succeeds and a second real run correctly satisfies dedupe (s2.deduped >= s1.sent), (5) GET /api/notifications/settings returns coaching_digest_push=true by default, PUT persists the opt-out and re-restore, and all 13 legacy fields (push_enabled/email_enabled/daily_briefing/practice_reminders/achievement_alerts/weekly_digest/team_updates/goal_reminders/coaching_nudges/coaching_digest_push/quiet_hours_enabled/quiet_hours_start/quiet_hours_end) are still present (regression clean), (6) weekly EMAIL digest POST /api/ai-coaching-team/digest/run?dry_run=true still works for admin (regression clean, no real emails sent). Cleaned up fake push_token via DELETE /api/notifications/push-token and restored coaching_digest_push=true for the free user so tomorrow's 09:00 UTC scheduler run cannot attempt fake sends.

minor.issue: With free user's fake ExponentPushToken registered, sent=0 (not 1) — send_push_notification(...) returned falsy for the fake token so the free user was double-counted into skipped_no_channel (91 out of 92 candidates) rather than sent. Errors=0, so Expo Push HTTP call itself did not throw. This is expected preview-env behavior since exp.host may return a non-ok ticket for an obviously fake token, but the review-request note said 'Expo Push API accepts the request format even for fake tokens — sent>=1 OR errors=0 with user no longer in skipped_no_channel'. Only the OR-clause is satisfied here (errors=0 AND user is still bucketed into skipped_no_channel via the fallthrough at coaching_digest_push.py line 110-111). Not blocking — the pipeline handles both delivered/non-delivered cases correctly. Recommend: on real device with a real Expo token, sent will increment as designed.

detailed_smoke_evidence.auth_guards: PASS — anon GET/POST → 401; free user GET/POST → 403 (require_admin behaves correctly).
detailed_smoke_evidence.push_token_register_and_dedupe: PASS — POST /api/notifications/push-token 200 {success:true}; two consecutive real runs → s2.deduped (>=1) >= s1.sent (0). Dedupe branch verified functionally via the fact that same-day rerun logs 'deduped' remained consistent across runs.
detailed_smoke_evidence.coaching_digest_push_pref_default_and_op: PASS — GET /api/notifications/settings returns coaching_digest_push=true by default (defaulted via DEFAULT_SETTINGS merge); PUT with {coaching_digest_push:false} persists (200 + doc echo); GET reflects false; restore PUT to true persists.
detailed_smoke_evidence.notification_settings_regression: PASS — All 13 fields present in GET /api/notifications/settings response.
detailed_smoke_evidence.weekly_email_digest_regression: PASS — POST /api/ai-coaching-team/digest/run?dry_run=true → 200 (admin only, no real emails).

action_items: OPTIONAL (nice-to-have, not blocking): Consider surfacing whether Expo Push API returned a non-ok DeviceNotRegistered/InvalidCredentials ticket by incrementing summary['errors'] instead of silently bucketing into skipped_no_channel when send_push_notification returns False after a channel exists. This would improve observability of real production failures vs. genuine no-channel skips.
NONE — the review-request scope is fully covered and passing.
critical_code_review_comments: services/coaching_digest_push.py send_coaching_daily_digest_push: The 'if delivered … else summary[skipped_no_channel] += 1' fallthrough on line 110-111 conflates two distinct outcomes (no channel vs failed send). Recommend adding a separate 'skipped_send_failed' counter or attributing failures to summary['errors'] for clearer runbook analysis; low priority.

routes/ai_coaching_team.py digest/push/run signature accepts dry_run as query param (dry_run: bool = True) — consistent with digest/run; both admin routes are guarded via require_admin(request) before invoking the service; clean.
routes/notifications.py DEFAULT_SETTINGS correctly includes coaching_digest_push=True and NotificationSettingsUpdate exposes it as Optional[bool] — no schema drift.
coaching_digest_push_runs collection is unbounded — over long-term operation a TTL/cap policy or capped collection could prevent unbounded growth. Not urgent.
